name: Security Operations Centre Analyst
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)
tools: A SIEM such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk or Elastic Security
An endpoint detection and response tool

beginner.summary: For aspiring and new security operations centre analysts. Covers the role and tiers of a SOC, a monitoring lab, logs and telemetry, the SIEM, the MITRE ATT&CK framework, the alert queue and triage, investigating alerts, common attack detection, endpoint detection and response, network detection, email and phishing analysis, identity and authentication monitoring, threat intelligence basics, the incident response lifecycle, escalation and handover, documentation and metrics, automation basics and analyst wellbeing. Prepares for CySA+ and SC-200.
prerequisites: Understands networking, operating systems and the command line
Knows basic security concepts such as the CIA triad
outcomes: Explain the SOC role, tiers and workflow
Triage and investigate alerts in a SIEM using ATT&CK
Detect common attacks across endpoint, network, email and identity
Follow the incident response lifecycle, escalate well and record work clearly

days.topic: The Security Operations Centre: Role, Tiers and Workflow
subtopics: What a security operations centre does
The monitor, triage, investigate and respond cycle
Internal and managed security operations centres
Course project overview: defending a lab company
days.lab_task: Map the SOC workflow for the lab company from alert to resolution and describe what each tier does at each step.
checks: Service levels and queues are explained

days.topic: Monitoring Lab Setup and the Analyst Toolkit
subtopics: Generating benign and malicious test events
days.lab_task: Build a monitoring lab with a SIEM, connect three log sources and generate a test alert to confirm the pipeline works end to end.
checks: Logs from three sources reach the SIEM
A test alert appears in the queue
The lab and sources are documented

days.lab_task: Collect and read logs from Windows, Linux and a firewall in the lab, line up their timestamps and find a gap in coverage.
days.deliverable: Log review with a coverage gap
checks: Key fields are identified in each log type

days.topic: Working in the SIEM: Searching and Dashboards
days.lab_task: Write searches in the lab SIEM to answer three questions about activity, save them and build a simple monitoring dashboard.
checks: Each question is answered with a query

days.topic: The MITRE ATT&CK Framework for Analysts
days.lab_task: Map five lab alerts to ATT&CK tactics and techniques and build a small coverage layer in the Navigator.
checks: How ATT&CK helps triage is explained

days.lab_task: Triage ten lab alerts, decide close or escalate for each with a reason, and record the triage in tickets.
checks: Each alert has a decision and reason
True and false positives are identified

subtopics: Confirming or ruling out an incident
days.lab_task: Investigate a suspicious lab alert by building a timeline and pivoting across host, user and network data, then decide whether it is an incident.
checks: A timeline of events is built

days.lab_task: Detect four seeded attacks in the lab, map each to ATT&CK and record the evidence that confirms it.

days.topic: Endpoint Detection and Response in the SOC
subtopics: What endpoint detection and response does
days.lab_task: Investigate an endpoint alert using the process tree, isolate the host and collect artefacts, then explain the response actions.
checks: The process tree explains the alert

days.lab_task: Analyse lab traffic to find beaconing and a suspicious DNS pattern, confirm with a packet capture and record the findings.
checks: A packet capture confirms the pattern

subtopics: Why email is a top vector
Sender authentication with SPF, DKIM and DMARC
Recognising phishing and business email compromise
days.lab_task: Analyse a reported phishing email by reading headers, checking authentication and safely examining the link and attachment, then recommend actions.
checks: SPF, DKIM and DMARC results are read
Actions for the email are recommended

subtopics: Why identity is a key signal
days.lab_task: Investigate a seeded account compromise using sign-in logs, confirm the compromise and recommend containment actions.
Enrich three lab alerts with threat intelligence, record the confidence of each source and decide how it changes the triage.

subtopics: The analyst's part in each phase
days.lab_task: Take a confirmed lab incident through the lifecycle from detection to recovery using a playbook and record each phase.
Write an escalation for a confirmed incident and a shift handover note that lets the next analyst continue without loss of context.
checks: The escalation has the needed detail

subtopics: Mean time to detect and respond
days.lab_task: Document a full investigation in a ticket with evidence and a timeline, and calculate the mean time to detect and respond for a set of tickets.
checks: The ticket has evidence and a timeline
Detection and response times are calculated

days.lab_task: Automate alert enrichment in the lab so new alerts gain context automatically, with a guardrail, and measure the time saved.

days.topic: Detection Tuning and False Positive Management
days.lab_task: Find the noisiest lab rule, tune it to cut false positives without losing the real detection and record the change.

days.topic: Analyst Wellbeing and Working in a SOC
days.lab_task: Review a week of simulated shift data for fatigue signs and propose practical changes to workload, rotation and support.

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: A Shift in the Security Operations Centre
days.lab_task: Work a simulated SOC shift for the lab company: triage the queue, investigate and confirm an incident, escalate it, document everything and report shift metrics.
days.deliverable: Completed shift with tickets and metrics
checks: The queue is triaged with reasons
An incident is investigated and escalated

intermediate.summary: For working SOC analysts moving to tier 2, aligned with CySA+ and SC-200. Covers detection engineering, writing detections in the SIEM, Sigma rules, advanced SIEM use, user and entity behaviour analytics, threat hunting, cloud and identity detection, endpoint forensics, memory and malware triage, network forensics, SOAR playbook building, threat intelligence programmes, incident response in depth, purple teaming, detection coverage, specific platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel and Splunk, reporting and certification practice.
prerequisites: Has worked the SOC alert queue and investigated incidents
Comfortable with a SIEM query language
Understands ATT&CK and the incident lifecycle
outcomes: Engineer and tune detections, including Sigma rules
Hunt threats and build behavioural detections
Investigate endpoints, memory, malware and network forensics
Build SOAR playbooks, run incidents and prepare for CySA+ and SC-200

subtopics: Writing a detection from a technique
days.lab_task: Take an ATT&CK technique, write a detection for it in the lab SIEM, test it with true and false events and store it in version control.
days.deliverable: A tested detection in version control
checks: The detection fires on the technique
False events do not trigger it

days.lab_task: Write three detections in the lab SIEM using joins, thresholds and a time window, and tune them for performance and accuracy.
Write a Sigma rule for a technique, convert it to the lab SIEM's query language and confirm it fires on seeded data.
days.deliverable: A Sigma rule converted and tested
checks: It converts to the SIEM query

days.topic: Advanced SIEM Use and Content Management
days.lab_task: Onboard a new log source to the lab SIEM, normalise its fields, add an enrichment lookup and build a use case on it.
days.deliverable: Onboarded source with a use case
checks: The new source is parsed and normalised
A use case fires on the new source

tools: Behaviour analytics in a lab SIEM
days.lab_task: Use behaviour analytics on seeded data to find an insider anomaly, investigate the risk score and confirm or clear it.
checks: The anomaly is confirmed or cleared

days.lab_task: Run a hypothesis-driven hunt in the lab against seeded activity, document the hunt and convert a finding into a detection.
days.deliverable: Threat hunt record with a detection
checks: A clear hypothesis guides the hunt

subtopics: Identity and access signals in the cloud
days.lab_task: Detect a seeded cloud attack such as a risky role change or public storage from cloud logs, investigate it and recommend response actions.

days.topic: Identity Threat Detection in the SOC
days.lab_task: Detect a seeded token theft in the lab, confirm the hijacked session and run the containment steps of revoking sessions and resetting credentials.
Collect artefacts from a compromised lab endpoint, build a timeline of the attacker's actions and link the artefacts to ATT&CK techniques.

subtopics: Dynamic malware triage in a sandbox
days.lab_task: Analyse a lab memory image to find a suspicious process, triage the related sample statically and dynamically and extract indicators.
checks: The suspicious process is found in memory

days.lab_task: Reconstruct an attacker session from a lab packet capture, extract a transferred file and link the activity to the endpoint evidence.
checks: Network and endpoint evidence line up

days.lab_task: Build a SOAR playbook that enriches a phishing alert, checks reputation, and either closes it or escalates with an approval step, then test it.
checks: The playbook runs end to end

days.lab_task: Ingest a threat report into a lab intelligence platform, turn its indicators into detections and write a short strategic summary for the SOC.
Lead a seeded multi-host incident in the lab through classification, containment, eradication and recovery, and run a post-incident review.
Run a set of atomic tests in the lab, measure which were detected, close two gaps with new detections and retest.
checks: Detection of each test is recorded
Two gaps are closed and retested

days.lab_task: Build an ATT&CK coverage map of the lab's detections, find the highest-priority blind spots and plan how to close them.

subtopics: User and entity behaviour analytics in Sentinel
days.lab_task: In a Sentinel lab, connect a data source, write a Kusto detection, create an analytics rule and investigate the resulting incident.

days.topic: Working with Splunk and Elastic Security
days.lab_task: Build the same detection in Splunk or Elastic Security as you built in Sentinel and compare the query, workflow and results.
checks: The detection fires on the second platform
Query and workflow differences are noted
A platform choice is justified for a scenario

days.lab_task: Build a SOC metrics dashboard from lab data, write a weekly report for management and propose two improvements from the data.
checks: Two improvements come from the data

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Detection Engineering and Incident Response Project
days.lab_task: Engineer new detections for the lab, validate them with purple teaming, run a resulting incident through response and forensics and report coverage and metrics.
days.deliverable: Project record with detections and an incident
checks: An incident is handled with forensics

advanced.summary: For senior analysts, detection engineers and SOC leads. Covers SOC strategy and operating models, detection engineering programmes, advanced threat hunting, threat intelligence-led operations, adversary emulation and purple team programmes, cloud and identity detection at scale, detection as code pipelines, data and telemetry strategy, SOAR and automation programmes, incident command, forensic programmes, managed and hybrid SOC models, measuring and maturing a SOC, analyst development, artificial intelligence in the SOC, insider threat programmes, regulatory and legal duties and designing a resilient detection and response capability.
prerequisites: Has worked as a tier 2 analyst or detection engineer
Strong SIEM, hunting and incident response skills
Takes part in SOC design or leadership
outcomes: Design SOC strategy, operating models and telemetry strategy
Run detection engineering, hunting and adversary emulation programmes
Build automation, incident command and forensic capabilities
Measure and mature a SOC and apply AI responsibly

subtopics: SOC models: internal, managed and hybrid
days.lab_task: Design a SOC operating model for a growing company with functions, staffing, tooling and service levels, and present it to a leadership persona.
Design a detection engineering programme with intake, prioritisation, standards and a testing pipeline, and run one detection through it end to end.
checks: A detection goes through the pipeline

subtopics: Analytics and machine learning in hunts
Turning hunts into detections and intelligence
days.lab_task: Design a hunting programme with cadence and threat-informed hunts, run one advanced hunt and feed its results into detections and intelligence.
days.deliverable: Hunting programme and one advanced hunt
checks: The programme has cadence and themes

subtopics: Driving detection and hunting from intelligence
days.lab_task: Define priority intelligence requirements for the company, run a collection and analysis cycle and drive one detection and one hunt from the result.
checks: A collection and analysis cycle is run
A detection and a hunt come from intelligence

days.topic: Adversary Emulation and Purple Team Programmes
subtopics: Adversary emulation at the programme level
days.lab_task: Build a purple team programme with an emulation plan for a chosen adversary, run it with the blue team and show detection improvement over two rounds.
checks: The emulation plan matches the adversary
Two rounds are run with the blue team

days.topic: Cloud and Multi-Cloud Detection at Scale
subtopics: Control plane and data plane telemetry
days.lab_task: Design cloud detection coverage across two clouds, build detections for key cloud attack techniques and plan cloud incident response.
checks: Detections fire on seeded cloud attacks

days.topic: Identity Detection and Response at Scale
days.lab_task: Design identity detection and automated response for hybrid identity, detect a seeded advanced identity attack and run automated containment.

days.topic: Detection as Code and SOC Engineering Pipelines
days.lab_task: Build a detection-as-code pipeline that tests and deploys detections to the lab SIEM with change control and rollback.
checks: Detections are tested in the pipeline
A bad detection is rolled back

days.topic: Telemetry and Data Strategy for the SOC
days.lab_task: Design a telemetry strategy for the SOC that improves coverage while controlling cost, with tiering, retention and a pipeline design.
Design a SOAR programme with a playbook portfolio, standards and guardrails, and build one end-to-end automated response with approvals.

days.topic: Incident Command and Major Incident Management
subtopics: Communication with executives and the public
days.lab_task: Lead a simulated major incident with incident command, executive communication and breach notification, then run the post-incident review.
checks: Executive and notification duties are met

subtopics: Forensic readiness at the programme level
Working with legal and external experts
days.lab_task: Assess and improve the SOC's forensic readiness, set evidence handling standards and run a programme-level investigation of a seeded incident.
checks: Readiness gaps are found and improved

days.topic: Managed, Hybrid and Co-Managed SOC Models
days.lab_task: Compare in-house, managed and co-managed models for the company, draft key service levels and plan how to keep critical functions in-house.
checks: Models are compared on control, cost and risk

days.lab_task: Assess the SOC against a maturity model, set target levels and build an improvement roadmap linked to risk.
checks: Current maturity is scored with evidence

days.lab_task: Build a skills framework and development path for SOC analysts, and plan a training and mentoring programme that reduces burnout.

days.topic: Artificial Intelligence in the Security Operations Centre
subtopics: Where AI helps in the SOC
AI for detection and anomaly finding
Governance for AI in the SOC
days.lab_task: Evaluate an AI assistant on replayed alerts, compare its triage with analyst triage and define where it may act with guardrails.
checks: AI triage is compared with analysts
Guardrails for AI action are defined

subtopics: Working with human resources and legal
days.lab_task: Design an insider threat detection approach with privacy limits, detect a seeded insider case and handle the investigation appropriately.
checks: Signals and privacy limits are defined
The investigation respects privacy and process

days.topic: Regulatory, Legal and Compliance Duties for the SOC
days.lab_task: Map the SOC's regulatory and notification duties for a breach scenario, and build an evidence and notification checklist.
checks: Duties for the scenario are mapped

days.topic: Security Data Lakes and Next-Generation SIEM
subtopics: Migrating detections to a data lake
tools: A data lake or next-generation SIEM
days.lab_task: Compare a traditional SIEM with a data lake approach for the SOC, run the same detection on both and weigh cost, scale and workflow.
checks: The detection works on both approaches
Cost, scale and workflow are compared
objectives: Compare SIEM and data lake models

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Designing a Resilient Detection and Response Capability
days.lab_task: Design a resilient detection and response capability for the company covering operating model, detection engineering, hunting, automation, incident command and a maturity roadmap, and present it to leadership.
checks: The operating model and engineering are defined
Automation and incident command are covered
A maturity roadmap with metrics is presented
objectives: Design a detection and response capability
